SECTION 3: Group definitions
5          AAA01 Avenello flexuosae-Callunetum vulgaris
(<Calluna vulgarisUP25>AND<### Festuca supina>)NOT<Empetrum nigrum s.lat.UP25>
5          AAA02 Junco trifidi-Empetretum hermaphroditi
